ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, banking, licensing, and material ownership changes, screen the company, directors, authorized representatives, shareholders, UBOs, lenders, payment partners, and key service providers against United Nations sanctions, applicable European Union restrictive measures, Spanish domestic sanctions and terrorism lists, and commercially reliable PEP, RCA, adverse-media, and law-enforcement databases. OFAC screening is not generally a standalone statutory requirement for a Spanish entity but is mandatory where a US nexus, US correspondent bank, US person, US dollar clearing, or contractual policy applies. PEP relationships require enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, enhanced ongoing monitoring, and documented risk assessment under Law 10/2010. Potential matches require identity resolution and documented disposition before onboarding; confirmed EU or Spanish sanctions matches require asset-freezing and reporting procedures.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central online services: https://www.rmc.es/
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be distinct from existing registered names and must include the legal-form designation or its accepted abbreviation, such as Sociedad Limitada or S.L. Names may use Spanish or another legally acceptable language, but must comply with Spanish public-order, morality, accuracy, and non-confusion rules. Foreign-language names, transliterations, abbreviations, and trade descriptions must not create misleading impressions regarding regulated status, governmental affiliation, banking status, or licensed financial activity. A Spanish sworn translation may be required for foreign public documents supporting the application.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any protected trademark, public-authority designation, or term implying a regulated authorization without the corresponding legal basis
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Submit a name-certificate application to the Registro Mercantil Central with up to five proposed names, ordered by preference, and obtain the negative certificate confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered. The certificate is ordinarily valid for three months for execution of the incorporation deed, while the name reservation may remain effective for up to six months; the 30-day value in this dossier is an internal filing-control window and is not the statutory maximum. If rejected, obtain the written reason, correct the proposed name, and resubmit. A formal administrative challenge may be filed with the competent authority of the Registro Mercantil Central within the applicable procedural deadline under Law 39/2015. Registry decisions affecting registration may be challenged before the Directorate-General for Legal Certainty and Public Faith and, subsequently, before the competent administrative court. Name clearance does not authorize regulated financial activity.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Spanish S.L. must maintain a registered office in Spain under the Companies Act. A serviced or virtual office may be acceptable for registered-office purposes if it is a genuine address capable of receiving official notices and maintaining legally required corporate records. It is not sufficient, by itself, for a regulated lending or financial-intermediation business. A P2P micro-lending platform must establish demonstrable Spanish operational substance proportionate to its activities, including accountable management, compliance and AML functions, secure records, customer-support capability, technology governance, complaint handling, and access for CNMV, Banco de España, SEPBLAC, tax, consumer-protection, and other competent authorities. Authorization analysis is required under Regulation (EU) 2020/1503, Law 5/2015 on the Promotion of Business Financing, Law 16/2011 on consumer credit, Law 2/2009 where mortgage-credit intermediation is involved, payment-services legislation, and any applicable lending or consumer-finance regime.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official Spain-wide statistical probability is published. For a newly formed high-risk fintech conducting consumer lending, the practical risk of a physical or remote supervisory inspection during the first three years is assessed at approximately 30% to 50%, increasing materially where a license application, regulatory complaint, suspicious-transaction pattern, weak substance, high-risk jurisdictions, or material AML deficiencies exists. This is a compliance risk estimate, not an official probability.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, Texto Refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC): arts. 20-22 (incorporation), art. 23 (statutory content), arts. 24-31 (contribution rules), arts. 33-39 (notarial deed and registration), arts. 87-89 (SL minimum capital of EUR 3,000 fully paid), arts. 124-125 (registered office), arts. 209-218 (board of directors). Complementary: Ley 14/2013 de apoyo a los emprendedores (fast incorporation regime); Royal Decree 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Notary public (Notario) for the public deed; Registro Mercantil Central for the name certificate; Registro Mercantil de Madrid for the legal-personality inscription; Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) for the NIF/CIF applications.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public incorporation deed) executed before a notary and filed with the Registro Mercantil for inscription; the notary's copy (copia autorizada) constitutes the governing corporate deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SL requires minimum share capital of EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and fully paid up at incorporation. For cash contributions, the amounts must be deposited in a blocked bank escrow account opened for the company in formation, evidenced by a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) released only upon execution of the deed. Contributions in-kind require an independent expert valuation report under art. 67 LSC. There is no state-level escrow body; Spanish commercial banks and the notary jointly administer the blocked deposit.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED at the founding meeting and first board of the Company: (1) the share subscriptions of the founding members under the deed of incorporation are ratified, and the paid-in capital of EUR 3,000, deposited in bank escrow, is acknowledged; (2) the registered office is fixed at Calle de Alcalá 85, 28014 Madrid, and adopted as the statutory seat, the company to be inscribed in the Madrid Mercantile Registry; (3) [Name, ID] is appointed Sole Managing Director and [Name, ID] is appointed AML Compliance Officer, both accepting office by signing the minutes; (4) the officers are jointly authorized to complete registry, tax, banking, and licensing filings. So resolved and minuted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain certificate of non-identical company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Ministerio de Justicia (online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for the 'certificación negativa de denominación social' confirming that the proposed SL name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing Spanish company name. The certificate is valid for three months and must be appended to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Copy of founders' valid passport or NIE
Proposed corporate name and at least two alternative names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, immediately file a revised application with the alternates; if the certificate expires before deed execution, renew the application and re-submit to the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open escrow account and deposit EUR 3,000 minimum capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution (bank) cooperating with the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders open a provisional account in the name of the company in formation, deposit the full minimum paid-up capital of EUR 3,000, and obtain a blocked-deposit certificate. The bank must confirm that the funds are immobilized for the exclusive release to the future company upon notarial deed execution. The certificate is delivered to the notary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML/KYC objections, provide enhanced source-of-funds evidence or select another Spanish credit entity; if the certificate contains defects, request a corrected bank certificate before the notarial appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare articles of association and deed of incorporation with the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (notary office within the territorial district of the intended registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary with the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, founders' personal data, corporate purpose (P2P micro-lending platform), corporate governance rules, quota apportionment, and registered office address. The notary vets legality under the LSC and prepares the 'escritura pública de constitución' together with the bylaws.
required_dossiers: Detailed draft bylaws and corporate purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or future registrar identifies defects, amend the draft statutory clauses by addendum (acta de subsanación) or prepare a new draft; certified alternatives should be agreed before public execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute public incorporation deed before the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding members appear personally or by attorney. The notary verifies identity and legal capacity, certifies the deposit certificate, reads the deed aloud, obtains signatures, and issues the authenticated first copy and a registration copy. The notary simultaneously submits the provisional NIF request through AEAT's telematic system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect emerges during execution, suspend the deed, execute a corrective addendum in the same protocol, or cancel and re-execute; no registry filing may proceed with a defective deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain provisional tax identification number (NIF provisional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), via notary telematics or provincial tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary registers the company's provisional NIF/CIF electronically. The founders confirm tax domicile, registered office, and corporate purpose; the provisional NIF allows bank account finalization, pre-registration contracts, and legal acts prior to Registry inscription.
required_dossiers: Authenticated copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT issues a query regarding identity or tax domicile, submit a written response through the electronic office within 10 business days; if unresolved, request an in-person appointment at the provincial AEAT delegation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for definitive NIF with AEAT
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of deed execution, file Modelo 036/037 requesting the definitive tax identification number. Attach the first copy of the public deed and provisional NIF document. AEAT issues the definitive CIF and enrols the company in the Census of Entrepreneurs, Professionals and Retainers.
required_dossiers: Original first copy of the public deed
Power of attorney, if the filing is made by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT objects to the registered office or corporate purpose, first correct the deed before the notary, then re-file Modelo 036; any administrative denial may be appealed by recurso de reposición within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscribe the company in the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil de Madrid (provincial Mercantile Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the authenticated deed within one month of execution together with the registration forms. The registrar examines legality, capacity, and compliance with the LSC (calificación registral). If approved, the company is entered on its registry sheet and acquires full legal personality.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a 'nota de defectos' is issued, cure the defects by executing a corrective public deed before the same or another notary and re-present; if the registrar refuses final inscription, appeal to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration filings: census update, legalization of corporate books, and employer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT; Registro Mercantil de Madrid; Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, update the Form 036 census data with the definitive NIF, legalize the corporate books (stock ledger, minutes book, daily journal, inventories and annual accounts) at the Mercantile Registry, and register the company as an employer with TGSS. Appoint the occupational-risk-prevention service and arrange payroll/insurance formalities.
required_dossiers: Board minutes appointing the management team
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the book-legalization application is rejected, replace any defective folio or book and re-present; if TGSS disputes the employer classification, update the contribution account code and re-file; any Registry objection is curable by supplementary documents or notarial rectification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV) and the Directorate General of Treasury and Financial Policy, Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa — for the participatory financing platform authorization under Law 5/2015; Madrid City Council (Ayuntamiento de Madrid) for the municipal establishment licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registration and authorization as 'Plataforma de Financiación Participativa' (PFP) under Ley 5/2015, de 27 de abril, de fomento de la financiación empresarial, arts. 46-58, including a fit-and-proper assessment; and the municipal 'Licencia de apertura y funcionamiento de establecimiento' for the physical operational office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD); municipal environmental services of Madrid
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not subject to full environmental impact assessment — fintech office activity falls outside Annexes I and II of Ley 21/2013 de evaluación ambiental; the applicable instrument is the municipal 'declaración responsable ambiental' or low-tier activity licence under Madrid's environmental sustainability ordinance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with the municipal sewerage ordinance and Real Decreto 849/1986 (dominio público hidráulico), with typical thresholds of pH 6-9, COD below 500 mg/l, and TSS below 400 mg/l; indoor air quality under UNE 171330-2; VOC emissions from materials and cleaning products controlled under Ley 34/2007 and RD 117/2003; waste handling must be contracted with a registered waste manager, including WEEE for IT equipment under RD 110/2015.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification per the Código Técnico de la Edificación (CTE DB-SI) and a plan de autoprotección approved by the competent local body, including extinguisher maintenance under RD 513/2017; occupational clearance under Ley 31/1995 de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, RD 486/1997 (workstation conditions) and RD 1215/1997 (work equipment); the building must hold the Inspección Técnica del Edificio (ITE) where required by municipal rules, together with a positive report from the municipal opening inspection (licencia de apertura).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es (Electronic Tax Office portal for registrations, filings, and SII submissions)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Execute public incorporation deed before a notary and deposit share capital. Step 2: Obtain provisional NIF (CIF) by filing Modelo 036 with AEAT, usually transmitted electronically by the notary. Step 3: Register the SL with the Registro Mercantil (Commercial Registry) within 2 months of execution. Step 4: Submit the registry certificate to AEAT to obtain the definitive NIF in the format Bxxxxxxxxx. Step 5: Enroll in the Censo de Empresarios, declare commencement of activity via IAE (economic activities tax), and complete VAT registration (IVA, Modelo 036). Non-resident directors or shareholders must appoint tax representation and obtain an NIE; there is no minimum share capital requirement, but the dominant notarial standard is €3,000 for an SL (Ley de Sociedades de Capital and Law 2/1995).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – The Spanish SL is a resident corporate taxpayer subject to Impuesto sobre Sociedades (Corporate Income Tax, Law 27/2014, LIS) at the 25% standard rate; a 15% reduced rate applies for newly created companies during the first two taxable years with a positive tax base, up to €300,000 (20% on the excess), per art. 29.1 LIS. Tax residence is based on incorporation under Spanish law or effective place of management, triggering worldwide taxation (art. 8 LIS). Pass-through treatment is not available; distributions are separately taxed at shareholder level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Check-the-box is not available under Spanish law. Available elections: (a) Consolidated tax group regime (arts. 61–75 LIS) for Spanish group members with ≥75% direct or indirect ownership; (b) VAT group election subject to sector conditions; (c) Patent box election (art. 23 LIS) granting 60% exemption on qualifying intangible income with substantial-activity nexus; (d) optional bad-debt provision for lending entities (deductible provision capped at 1% of the annual increase in loan loss provisions, art. 13.2.b LIS); (e) optional CIT prepayment methods; (f) hybrid mismatch restrictions transposed in art. 15 bis LIS, eliminating elective hybrid structuring for cross-border P2P instruments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (IVA) – Spanish value added tax under Ley 37/1992, harmonized with EU Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis threshold for locally established SLs: VAT registration is compulsory from the first transaction (Modelo 036). For non-established third-country providers of B2C digital or lending services, registration is required immediately for services rendered in Spain; for intra-EU distance sales/teleservices, the EU-wide OSS registration threshold is €10,000. The P2P platform's core activities (credit granting, credit intermediation, including origination fees) are VAT-exempt under art. 20.Uno.18º and 19º LIVA, so no VAT is charged and input VAT is non-deductible; separately invoiced technology or underwriting services supplied to Spanish counterparties may be outside the exemption and subject to 21% IVA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Ley 18/2022 (Crea y Crece) and Royal Decree 1007/2023 (VERI-FACTU) mandate structured electronic invoicing (Facturae XML or EDI) for all B2B transactions, requiring interoperable software, QR-code/digital stamp conditions, and archived invoice records. Large taxpayers (annual turnover exceeding €6,010,121.04) and consolidated VAT-group members are subject to the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información del IVA): invoice records transmitted to AEAT through authenticated SOAP/XML APIs (digital certificate, SHA-256 hash) within 8 calendar days of issuance (4 days for monthly SII filers). The SII is a reporting clearance system, not a preissuance fiscal stamping system; non-SII taxpayers retain Modelo 303/390 periodic returns but must still issue VERI-FACTU-compliant e-invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to third countries and territories qualify for the 0% rate (exenta, art. 21 LIVA) with full input VAT deduction, provided the physical exit of goods from EU customs territory is evidenced. Intra-Community supplies (art. 25 LIVA) are 0% when the buyer holds a valid EU VAT number and Intrastat/sales-list filing obligations are met. Cross-border B2B services provided to non-resident entrepreneurs fall outside Spanish VAT under arts. 69–70 LIVA (place-of-supply rules), effectively achieving zero-rating with input recovery if the recipient is an entrepreneur acting as such. For the P2P micro-lending platform, core lending income is exempt, not zero-rated; outside-scope treatment may apply only to separately identifiable cross-border technology or underwriting services supplied to foreign institutional clients, subject to proper documentary substantiation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA/SAD) including the MRN (Movement Reference Number) validated by Spanish customs via the electronic customs filing system
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing physical exit from EU territory
Commercial invoice in triplicate and packing list
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank transfer evidence matching the invoice amount and payment deadline
Sales contract or service agreement evidencing the recipient's entrepreneur status and the place-of-supply analysis
Intrastat dispatch declaration (only for intra-EU movement of goods; not applicable to the lending platform)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT's limitation period is 4 years (art. 66 LGT). Insufficient export substantiation triggers recharacterization of the claimed 0% or outside-scope supply as domestic Spanish VAT at 21%, plus: (i) late-payment interest (interés de demora, circa 3.75% in 2025); (ii) penalties under arts. 27 and 191 LGT of 50% to 150% of omitted tax, with the 150% tier for intentional concealment; (iii) retrospective clawback of deducted input VAT, refunds, and affirmative assessment of output VAT, with a restart of the limitation period on undisclosed invoices; (iv) criminal tax fraud under art. 305 of the Código Penal where defrauded VAT exceeds €120,000 annually, carrying imprisonment of 1 to 5 years; (v) inclusion in AEAT public tax-debt registers and hard enforcement measures; (vi) for the Fintech licensee, adverse reports to Banco de España and CNMV potentially triggering suspension or revocation of the P2P platform authorization; (vii) artificial arrangements claiming zero-rating on lending services are rebutted under art. 15 LGT anti-abuse and art. 13 LIS substance-over-form rules.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains full capital account convertibility under EU free movement of capital rules. Current account transactions, including profit remittances to non-resident shareholders, face no convertibility restrictions within the Eurozone. Remittances are subject to 19% Spanish withholding tax on dividends and mandatory AML/CFT compliance. Profit remittance hurdles are minimal for Eurozone residents but require tax registration and beneficial ownership verification for non-residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For any foreign currency inflows or cross-border receipts (including lending repayments), Spanish entities must submit a foreign exchange declaration to Banco de España within 15 calendar days. No mandatory surrender ratio applies; voluntary surrender is permitted for statistical purposes only. Lending platform disbursements and repayments follow declaration-based rules without forced conversion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Legal constraints: Offshore digital EMIs are restricted under Spanish AML/CFT and MiCA regulations; licensed fintech lending platforms must partner exclusively with authorized payment institutions or banks for cross-border payouts to ensure full compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding is fully permitted for Spanish SL entities using advanced KYC platforms with video identification, biometric authentication, and electronic signing. Physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard corporate banking onboarding but may be required for high-risk lending operations or complex ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds or high-risk beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source of wealth statements, corporate resolutions, tax filings, loan origination records, and independent third-party verification reports

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Links to high-risk jurisdictions or sanctions exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence questionnaires, travel and transaction history, legal opinions, and beneficial ownership certificates

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections use SWIFT MT103 transfers to Spanish IBAN accounts with purpose code 'CAPITAL' or 'EQUITY'. All transactions require full KYC matching, beneficial ownership proof, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Inflows exceeding reporting thresholds must be declared to Banco de España.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements include SWIFT MT103 for international transfers and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for structured trade finance. For the micro-lending platform, borrower disbursements primarily utilize local SEPA and wallet rails, while any cross-border elements follow MT103 with purpose codes such as 'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT' and full compliance documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales) including balance sheet, profit-and-loss account, statement of changes in equity, statutory notes, management report, and audit report when applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry at the company's registered office (Registro Mercantil Provincial)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual general meeting must be held within six months after fiscal year-end; annual accounts must be submitted to the Mercantile Registry within one month after approval. For a calendar year-end, the effective timeline is approval by June 30 and deposit by July 31.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit triggers a penalty of EUR 1,200 plus EUR 12 per added month, capped at EUR 12,000; the company loses its ability to obtain certificates of good standing and to register any further documents; persistent non-filing may lead to the disclaimer of the company file and a strike-off procedure, and can impose joint and several liability on directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Modelo 200) for tax period and applicable advance payments (Modelo 202/222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (AEAT) – corresponding provincial tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months and 25 days after the end of the tax year; for calendar-year companies, April 1 to July 25 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing without prompt notice triggers a surcharge of 5% to 20% of the self-assessed amount plus late-payment interest; additional fines for inaccurate or incomplete returns; coercive collection can include bank attachments and license suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual third-party transaction information return (Modelo 347) for any transactions with a single counterparty exceeding EUR 3,005.06 in a calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By February 28 of the year following the calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is penalized at 1% of the aggregate transaction volume, with a minimum fine of EUR 300; if filed after an AEAT summons, the minimum rises to EUR 1,000; for false or incomplete data, fines can range from 2% to 4% of volume subject to minimums.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of ultimate beneficial ownership register (Registro de Titulares Reales) and communication of changes to the Mercantile Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry / Central Beneficial Ownership Registry (Registro Central de Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Beneficial ownership confirmation must accompany the annual accounts deposit; any change in ownership, control structure, or beneficial ownership must be filed within one month of the change or as prescribed by the applicable registry form.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update the beneficial ownership register is an independent regulatory infringement under Law 10/2010, with fines generally ranging from EUR 1,500 to EUR 600,000 depending on classification; non-filing also blocks registry filings and certificates of good standing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An SL must submit its annual accounts to a statutory auditor if, at the balance-sheet date, it satisfies at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive fiscal years: total assets of EUR 2,850,000; net turnover of EUR 5,700,000; average workforce of 50 employees. In addition, audit is mandatory where a group of shareholders owning at least 5% of the share capital requests it, for regulated P2P lending and crowdfunding platforms authorized by the CNMV, and for entities subject to solvency supervision.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual annual accounts are prepared under Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable, approved by Royal Decree 1514/2007, as amended), consistent with the EU Accounting Directive; consolidated accounts of a group are prepared under IFRS-EU as endorsed by the EU. Financial disclosures by lending platforms also observe CNMV reporting obligations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain an internal ultimate beneficial ownership register and review it annually at the time the annual accounts are approved. The annual accounts filing with the Mercantile Registry must confirm the existing beneficial owner(s) and, in case of any shareholder or control change, complete the registry form identifying the natural person(s) who directly or indirectly own or control the SL. Any variation in control or ownership exceeding the statutory threshold, or a change in the statutory data of an existing beneficial owner, must be communicated within one month after the change; for the annual confirmation, the effective date is linked to the deposits of the annual accounts.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)
Register of Minutes of General Meetings and Board Meetings (Libro de Actas)
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Libro Registro de Titulares Reales)
Register of Contracts with the Sole Shareholder (Libro de Contratos del Socio Único), if single-member SL
Shareholder Capital Transfer Register (Registro de Transmisiones de Participaciones), where maintained

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $500 – $1,500 typical annual fee for registered office address, corporate administration and legal representation services; higher where a Madrid registered office or specialized AML/CNMV compliance agent is required.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $4,500 – $12,000 typical certified audit fee for a small or middle-market SL; fees increase for a fintech platform subject to CNMV, AML, or payment-institution oversight and consolidated reporting.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25% rate applies; limited sector-specific incentives for fintech lending (e.g., R&D deductions under Law 11/2018)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via AEAT portal (Cl@ve or digital certificate)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25 days after fiscal year-end (e.g., 25 April for calendar year-end 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income after adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident Spanish SL computes base on worldwide income; non-residents file separate if applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 100-600 euros per day (max 6,000 euros); unpaid tax interest at 0.4% monthly plus surcharges

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% on dividends to non-resident shareholders (reduced by applicable treaty)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Apply for Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) via AEAT prior to dividend payment; submit beneficial ownership declaration and tax residence certificate
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19%; Interest: 19% (0% under EU Savings Directive for qualifying EU recipients)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File if consolidated group turnover exceeds 20 million euros
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain enforces Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) for high-risk activities including P2P lending; requires local management and decision-making to prevent transaction recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or understatement of taxable income in Modelo 100 filings
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offense; fines up to 100% of evaded tax, imprisonment 6 months to 6 years, and company dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability, fines, and disqualification from management roles

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Spanish SL without real economic activity or substance for tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 1 million euros; potential criminal prosecution and company dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for sanctions; possible asset freezes and travel restrictions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform adequate KYC, customer due diligence, or suspicious transaction reporting for high-risk P2P micro-lending
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 2 million euros or 2% of annual turnover; possible revocation of lending license by competent authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally responsible for fines and may face criminal charges for willful non-compliance
